description: Intelligence-powered merchandise creation expert. Handles product design, mockup generation, video production, and manufacturing coordination.

capabilities.name: search_assets
capabilities.description: Search for logos, designs, and images across all user projects in Creative Studio. Returns matching assets with URLs and metadata.

capabilities.name: create_product_mockup
capabilities.description: Generate photorealistic product mockup with design applied. Supports multiple product types and placements.

capabilities.name: generate_product_video
capabilities.description: Create cinematic product video from mockup. Generates promotional video with camera movements.

capabilities.name: submit_to_production
capabilities.description: Submit merchandise design to production/manufacturing. Returns order ID for tracking.

capabilities.name: ask_clarification
capabilities.description: Ask the user a clarifying question to better understand their needs. Use this when ambiguous.

capabilities.name: list_product_types
capabilities.description: Get available product types, placements, and configurations.
